description: Source file implementing POSIX file utility functions for Chromium project, including file operations, path validation, symbolic link handling, and directory management.

methods.name: VerifySpecificPathControlledByUser
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is owned by the user and not writable by unprivileged groups or others.

methods.name: TempFileName
methods.description: Returns a template string for temporary filenames.

methods.name: CopyFileContents
methods.description: Copies contents from one file to another.

methods.name: AppendModeCharacter
methods.description: Appends a mode character to a mode string, used for file opening modes.

methods.name: MakeAbsoluteFilePath
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path.

methods.name: DeleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory, optionally recursively.

methods.name: ReplaceFile
methods.description: Replaces one file with another.

methods.name: CreateLocalNonBlockingPipe
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking pipe.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: SetCloseOnExec
methods.description: Sets the close-on-exec flag on a file descriptor.

methods.name: PathExists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists.

methods.name: PathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if a path is writable.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists.

methods.name: CreateAndOpenFdForTemporaryFileInDir
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file in a specified directory.

methods.name: CreateSymbolicLink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link.

methods.name: ReadSymbolicLink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link.

methods.name: GetPosixFilePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves POSIX permissions of a file.

methods.name: SetPosixFilePermissions
methods.description: Sets POSIX permissions of a file.

methods.name: ExecutableExistsInPath
methods.description: Checks if an executable exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Retrieves the temporary directory path.

methods.name: GetHomeDir
methods.description: Retrieves the user's home directory.

methods.name: CreateAndOpenTemporaryFileInDir
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file in a directory.

methods.name: CreateTemporaryDirInDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory within a base directory.

methods.name: CreateNewTempDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new temporary directory with a prefix.

methods.name: CreateDirectoryAndGetError
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories, reporting errors.

methods.name: NormalizeFilePath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to an absolute, real path.

methods.name: IsLink
methods.description: Checks if a file path is a symbolic link.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file.

methods.name: OpenFile
methods.description: Opens a file with specified mode.

methods.name: FileToFILE
methods.description: Converts a File object to a FILE* stream.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads data from a file.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file.

methods.name: WriteFileDescriptor
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, allowing partial writes.

methods.name: AppendToFile
methods.description: Appends data to a file.

methods.name: GetCurrentDirectory
methods.description: Gets the current working directory.

methods.name: SetCurrentDirectory
methods.description: Sets the current working directory.

methods.name: VerifyPathControlledByUser
methods.description: Verifies if a path is controlled by the user based on ownership and permissions.

methods.name: VerifyPathControlledByAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if a path is controlled by admin group on macOS.

methods.name: GetMaximumPathComponentLength
methods.description: Gets maximum filename length for a path.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from one path to another.
